edges.reason: background parameter indexes the backgrounds array whose element is embedded in the returned SVG string.
checkerPattern parameter is used to derive the shield fragment included in the returned SVG.
color parameter indexes the colors array whose element is embedded in the returned SVG string.
eight parameter indexes the eights array whose element is embedded in the returned SVG string.
local bg is assigned from backgrounds[background].
local c is assigned from colors[color].
local e is assigned from eights[eight].
checkerPattern is passed as the argument of the _getShield call.
Return value of _getShield is stored in local s.
draw calls _getShield(checkerPattern) to build the shield markup.
draw calls _getBackground() to build the background markup.
draw calls _getOutline() to build the outline markup.
draw calls _getEights() to build the digit-eight markup.
When checkerPattern == 0 execution takes the branch returning _getBigShield().
When checkerPattern != 0 execution takes the else branch returning _getSmallShield().
